judge.rationale: The candidate's runtime implementation in `chatOrchestrator.ts` (`addUsage` and `totalUsage`) accurately accumulates usage across tool rounds and handles missing per-round usage identically to the reference. However, it misses the acceptance criterion requiring the hook's type signature to make the sum unambiguous—leaving `OrchestratorHooks.afterModelResponse`'s parameter named `usage` instead of renaming it to `totalUsage` in `chatOrchestrator.ts`, `CLAUDE.md`, and `specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md` (a gap even left unchecked in its own `.lore/dod.md`). Additionally, in `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md`, the candidate leaves the `afterModelResponse` bullets under the `Measured semantics — out of scope` section rather than moving the new behavior into the main specification. Finally, the candidate introduces a separate `chatOrchestratorUsage.acceptance.test.ts` file and leaves a `.lore/dod.md` artifact in the diff instead of keeping all unit tests consolidated in `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`.
